limits: Exterior drawing study, not verified installed conditions.
The dimensioned plan grids control footprint scale. Elevation grid spans do not agree uniformly with the plan; facade widths use explicit piecewise registration.
No single dimensional accuracy tolerance is established for this exterior model. Source picks, simplified wall returns and standardized window heights remain provisional/assumed.
Facade openings are surface-envelope studies; jamb details, exact opening schedule and recessed balconies are simplified.
Roof slopes, drains, equipment, landscaping, sidewalk and street geometry are simplified; surrounding buildings are omitted.
Finish families follow the user photos; exact colors, reflectance, recess depth and landscape positions remain interpreted.
Not suitable for quantities, facade access design or construction dimensions.
Visible front bays have been reassigned within the registered plan topology; their exact opening offsets remain assumed. Rear/north omitted candidates remain unresolved.

P1 now has its own A2.02 enclosure and all fourteen modeled P1 openings have plan jamb evidence. The open ventilation shaft, external planters/trellises, parking ramp, structural slab design and below-grade wall sections are not modeled or verified.

North R2-R5 geometry is unchanged from revision 04. The diagnostic maximum horizontal center discrepancy remains 42.443 overview-raster pixels; six windows per floor does not establish dimensional alignment. R1 north entries still need audit.

P1 and R5 sill/head heights, frame sections and coping profiles remain assumed. A2.08 supplies top datums, not the missing A4/A5 construction profiles. Model consistency is not an as-built or source-accuracy certificate.
R5 XY follows a manual orthogonal enclosure trace and per-sheet dimensioned-grid calibration. This establishes source-governed provisional placement, not verified as-built dimensions.
The north wall and stair/MU alignment retain revision 05 geometry and the 42.443-pixel diagnostic maximum. R1 north entries are also deferred.
South MO/MJ outer jambs and contiguous interface replace the former MO/MU transcription and unsupported masonry gap. Complete internal frame profiles remain assumed without the schedule.

R5 sill/head dimensions, wall and slab thicknesses, parapet/coping sections and guards remain assumed or provisional. A2.08 is an independent diagnostic comparison, not a second authority for floor-plan wall positions.
Differences between plan and elevation projections are reported as residuals. No common dimensional accuracy tolerance or source agreement certificate is asserted.
Guard arrangement is provisional from A2.07 and the exterior elevations. Height, infill, posts, connections and complete profiles are assumed; A6 stair guards are not used as exterior guard evidence.

Walking terraces and the south gravel planter are modeled separately. The east MR-window projection labeled with a cornice line above is not promoted to an occupied terrace or given an inferred guard.
J-west and K-east-door terrace tie-ins follow the deferred north wall endpoints; their source registration differences remain explicit.
Southwest, planter and southeast band tops retain provisional 26/28/30-inch source-scaled heights. Complete returns, projections and planter construction remain assumed.
The south clerestory footprint is re-registered to A2.08; its documented 407.75-foot complete top remains. Complete cap profile and four glazing sections remain assumed.
Drainage falls, thresholds, waterproofing, exterior guard compliance and installed conditions are not established by this coordination model.
No guard is placed across terrace edges that abut the R5 enclosure or its glazing. Only exposed edges receive the provisional guard paths.
